shortBio.en: King Crimson’s constant guitarist-composer across radical lineup reformations since 1968.
shortBio.zh: 自 1968 年起，在剧烈阵容重组中保持不变的 King Crimson 吉他手-作曲。

whyHub.en: Method person: Crimson is a way of working; Fripp is the through-line across casts.
whyHub.zh: 方法型人物：Crimson 是一种工作方式；Fripp 是跨人马的贯穿线。

body.en:
Born 1946. From Court of the Crimson King through 1970s improvising units to 1980s interlocking guitars and later configurations—Fripp remains while almost everyone else rotates.

Opposite teaching exhibit to Zeppelin’s stable IV: keep one hub, replace the instrument cast. Discipline and practice language are part of the archive.
body.zh:
1946 年生。从 Court of the Crimson King 经 1970 年代即兴单位到 1980 年代交织吉他与更后期编制——Fripp 留下，几乎其他人轮换。

相对 Zeppelin 稳定四人的反向教材：保留一个枢纽，更换乐器人马。纪律与练习语言属档案的一部分。
